title: Issue #3921 execution
intent: Root cause found (broadcast lag aborts status waits); RED/GREEN in Linux container
progress_summary: Merged develop (434 commits behind). Read the Issue plus 9 recorded failing tests across its comments. Found the mechanism in code: recv_issue_monitor_status_matching treated broadcast RecvError::Lagged as 'condition unreachable', and the retry barrier republishes every 50ms into a 64-frame channel, so any wait that pauses for >3.2s aborts instantly. Fixed the helper, added a deterministic regression test for it, and aligned the module's remaining 1-3s positive-wait budgets onto the shared 60s HANG_GUARD (renamed from MARKER_WAIT_HANG_GUARD). Also widened the two daemon_publisher busy-control budgets. Building in the rust:1-bookworm container (these tests are cfg(all(test, unix))).
